C280.continent_line: North America · Country: Belize · ISO: BZ
C280.metal: copper-nickel (75% copper, 25% nickel) · 5.66 g · 23.6 mm · reeded
C280.design: obverse crowned bust of Elizabeth II right within beaded circle · QUEEN ELIZABETH THE SECOND · reverse 25 CENTS within central beaded circle and ornamental border with BELIZE above and date below · Cecil Thomas (obverse)
C280.label: Belize · 2007 · 25 Cents
C280.notes: Phase 1 from the value side only (owner photo).
C280.story: A 2007 twenty-five-cent coin from Belize. The side shown has a large 25 and CENTS inside a beaded circle, with BELIZE above and the date below. The other side, not photographed yet, carries Queen Elizabeth II.
